key_idea: Colours are independent, and for each gap between consecutive uses of a colour you independently choose the cheaper of stranding through it (a * gap) or stopping and restarting (2c).
sketch: Scan the pattern once keeping the last position of each letter: the first occurrence costs 2c (one start plus the final stop), each later occurrence adds min(a*(gap length), 2c), and every occurrence adds b. Print the totals in the order of w; a colour of w that never appears costs 0. O(|p|). Totals reach about 1e9 or more, so use 64-bit.
